issue_context.title: Scheduler VolumeBinding plugin returns error instead of unschedulable
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:
Scheduler VolumeBinding plugin reports error when a PVC doesn't exist for example: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/9891ac4d4dd648c3f38d12e4e16fc55573b6606d/pkg/controller/volume/scheduling/scheduler_binder.go#L291

We need to take a second look at the VolumeBinding plugin and make sure that errors are returned only when there is a system error, not a user error.

**Why is this needed**:
To fix the scheduler's error reporting metrics.

/sig scheduling
/sig storage
/cc @cofyc

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/9891ac4d4dd648c3f38d12e4e16fc55573b6606d/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumebinding/volume_binding.go#L123-L126

I guess you mean the plugin will return an error when a referenced PV does not exist?

I've created a PR for this: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/95541
Thanks! The errors I am seeing are on 1.18 clusters, can we look at 1.18 and try to patch? This is still throwing the scheduler's error metrics off.
I've submitted a patch for the 1.18 release branch: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/96135
I guess https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/95541 on the master branch should be reviewed and merged too? cc @msau42
